version: LOCK 59 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: A thirsty dog
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: A thirsty dog
missions.button: A dog is panting by the well

a.text: A thin dog lies by the quay well with its tongue out, too weak to stand. The bucket is too deep for it. People step round it.

choices.label: Draw water and give it a drink

drink.text: You draw a bucket and tip some into the hollow of a stone. The dog drinks and drinks, then lies down in the shade. Nobody sees. It doesn't matter.

on.text: The dog is still there at sunset.
